contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]NST[---][?T] CAES. Reverse description: Wreath in vow inscribed VOT / X. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.80gms, die axis: 12
